### **Q1. CMUs Required**
* Wall height = $4'\text{-}0" = 4\text{ ft}$.
* Wall area = $\text{Perimeter} \times \text{Height} = 164\text{ ft} \times 4\text{ ft} = 656\text{ sf}$.
* Standard 8x8x16 CMU face area = $1.125\text{ sf}$ ($8\text{"} \times 16\text{"} = \frac{2}{3}\text{ sq ft}$, actually $1\text{ unit} = 0.889\text{ sf}$ face area, or use $1.125\text{ blocks per sq ft}$).
* Number of blocks per sq ft for CMU wall $\approx 1.125$ blocks/sf.
* Base blocks = $656\text{ sf} \times 1.125 = 738$ blocks.
* With 6% waste = $738 \times 1.06 = 782.28 \rightarrow 783$ CMUs.

### **Q2. Grout (Fully Grouted)**
* Volume per block = $0.26\text{ ft}^3$.
* Total blocks (without waste) = $738$.
* Total grout volume = $738 \times 0.26 = 191.88\text{ ft}^3$.
* With 7% waste = $191.88 \times 1.07 = 205.31\text{ ft}^3$.
* Convert to cubic yards ($1\text{ CY} = 27\text{ ft}^3$): $205.31 / 27 = 7.60\text{ CY}$.

### **Q3. Grout (At 16" O.C. Vertical Reinforcement)**
* Vertical reinforcement at $16"$ O.C. means every vertical cell is grouted (since standard CMUs are $16"$ long, one cell per block is grouted, which is equivalent to fully grouted for standard 2-core blocks where every web aligns with $16"$ spacing, or specifically 1 cell every $16"$).
* Wait, an 8" CMU has 2 cores, $16"$ long. Reinforcement at $16"$ O.C. means every $16"$ interval has a grouted cell. Since each block is $16"$ long and has 2 cores, grouting every $16"$ O.C. usually means grouting 1 core per block (every other core), which is half of the cells.
* Therefore, grouting at $16"$ O.C. takes half the grout of fully grouted:
* $7.60\text{ CY} / 2 = 3.80\text{ CY}$.

FINAL: Q1 = 783 CMU
FINAL: Q2 = 7.60 CY
FINAL: Q3 = 3.80 CY
